mission.display_title: Construct a confidence interval for a difference between two means from paired data
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to construct a confidence interval for a difference between two means from paired data — so paired-difference literacy is usable — without pretending bootstrap CIs (3.2.8) are finished.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force a paired mean-difference CI and refuse treating independent two-sample or bootstrap CI as today's LO.
mission.educational_intent: Produce a cognitive move from paired observations to a CI for the mean difference under CMP language.
mission.learning_objective: Confidence intervals for a difference between two means from paired data.
mission.concept_focus: Paired observations → differences → mean-difference CI → refuse bootstrap-as-done.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday you formed two-sample CIs (3.2.6). Today continues topic 3.2 at LO 3.2.7 — paired mean-difference intervals.
mission.why_now: 3.2.7 is contiguous after independent two-sample work. Closing it prevents a cliff at paired data while keeping bootstrap CI as day eight.
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for paired mean-difference CI — not Topic Complete for 3.2.8.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Lambda Day 7 because Continuity Front membership places paired-means CI after two-sample situations.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 3.2.7
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) What is the paired mean-difference CI move? (2) Why is pairing not the same as independent two-sample? (3) Name one reason bootstrap CI is not today's LO.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Form differences within pairs and construct a CI for the mean difference. Pairing exploits dependence — not the same as independent two-sample. Bootstrap CI is tomorrow.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 3.2.7
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A colleague says 'I reused yesterday's two-sample formula on paired rows and that finished both paired and bootstrap.' Refuse and restate today's LO.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: paired requires the paired-difference construction; bootstrap is tomorrow. Today is the paired mean-difference CI.
